description: This file contains functions and logic for platform-specific checks and upgrade procedures in the OpenWrt firmware build system. It defines methods for image validation, upgrades, and handling multiple hardware platforms and devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity or validity of a firmware image based on the device's board model.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific firmware upgrade procedures based on the hardware model.
